# Upstream commits this fork has consciously decided never to port.
# tools/upstream_triage.py skips anything listed here so it stops re-surfacing
# in the weekly Upstream watch report. One SHA per line (short or full); text
# after # is a note.
#
# Two kinds of commit belong here:
#
#   1. Reviewed and rejected on purpose.
#   2. Ported in adapted form. A straight cherry-pick drops off by itself once
#      the patch-id matches, but an adapted port never matches - the upstream
#      commit also touched files this fork does not carry, so the diff differs
#      and the report re-surfaces it every week. Record it here instead.
#
# Commits that only touch files your fork removed are auto-skipped - you do not
# need to list those.
